verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for a feedback-management SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents any way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Autopilot's automatic feedback capture and the integration status syncs are continuous ingestion and sync behaviors, not user-defined recurring schedules. MCP-driven actions are one-off agent operations, so none of this counts toward the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
